key_decisions.rationale: Keeps day, gathering, bread-breaking, Paul's speech, travel plan, and midnight duration.
key_decisions.before: On the first day of the week, when we gathered to break bread, Paul began speaking to them. Since he intended to leave the next day, he continued speaking until midnight.
key_decisions.after: On the first day of the week, when we gathered to break bread, Paul spoke with them. Because he intended to leave the next day, he continued speaking until midnight.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And on the first day of the week, when we were gathered together to break bread, Paul was speaking to them, intending to depart on the next day, and he prolonged the message until midnight.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves self-disregard, race image, received ministry, Jesus, testimony, gospel, and grace.
key_decisions.before: But I consider my life worth nothing to myself if only I may finish my course and the ministry I received from the Lord Jesus: to testify to the good news of God’s grace.
key_decisions.after: But I do not consider my life worth anything to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry I received from the Lord Jesus: to testify to the good news of God's grace.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But I consider my life of no account as dear to myself, so that I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves self-watch, flock, Spirit's appointment, oversight, shepherding, God's church, acquisition, and the difficult “blood of his own” construction.
key_decisions.before: Pay careful attention to yourselves and to the whole flock in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God, which he acquired with his own blood.
key_decisions.after: Watch over yourselves and the whole flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God, which he obtained through the blood of his own Son.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Take heed to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God, which he obtained with his own blood.
